title: 第2522章 不限次数第2521章 豺狼本色
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
“这不很正常么，以这小子的行事作风，肯定不会让我帮忙，他怕我要挟他。”
“至于为何才过来寻找，我觉得他可能因为修为低，所以等到突破后他才过来。”
袁芊芊煞有介事的分析道。
“家主的判断虽然有点道理，只是有一点却解释不通。”
“按说他应该不差钱，完全可以重金聘请几个高手护卫，或者干脆花钱雇人寻找，没必要以身涉险。”
邱仙子提出疑问。
“不找护卫这事倒是能解释，就因为他有钱，才不敢聘请高手，他应该是独来独往惯了，不相信身边的任何人。”
“至于为何不雇人寻找，或许他有不得已的苦衷，我对他的了解也不多，没法做出准确的判断。”
袁芊芊强行解释。
“家主，有没有一种可能，这次过来的并非黄总管，找寻佟仙子的事情只是这位监察使的个人行为，他只是拿着鸡毛当令箭。”
邱仙子想到另一种可能。
“不管哪种可能，我们按这小子亲自过来应对总没错。”
“反正他们又不是经常过来，只要我们在这段时间服务周到，他们就挑不出什么理。”
袁芊芊中断两人的哥德巴赫猜想。
“也对，属下确实有点儿想多了，属下这就安排具体事宜。”
邱仙子躬身退下。
袁芊芊的嘴角露出一丝玩味的笑意，笑得迷人，笑得阴险，笑得恐怖。
臭小子，这次不会真是你吧，到了老娘的地盘，老娘不把你吃干抹净才怪，反正这是老娘欠你的。
袁芊芊伸出小舌头在唇边舔舐一圈，大有一副灰太狼看到肥羊羊的架势。
黄夜也没想到，袁芊芊开盘便把目标锁定到自己身上，还对寻找佟姥的事儿如此上心。

双方顶多算一面之缘，两人的相识也是因为利益，这妞可以说已经达到目的。
代理商会议明确规定，想得到更多的份额，必须拿出高价值宝物才行。
会议结束到现在，已经有段时间，还没有一家送来高价值宝物，这妞兵不血刃便拿到一成份额，还要啥自行车？
别看这妞嘴里说想要三成份额，那不过是个幌子。
自己不想见这妞，只是因为这妞临走留下一句话，她不想欠自己人情，回去一定搜罗宝物。
这妞还想用身体当定金，让自己先把定金收下，看到自己一直婉拒，这妞便提出定金可以随取随用，不限次数。
别说不限次数，哪怕只来一次自己也不敢，鬼知道这妞到底怎么想的。
她可是七阶二层修士，自己当时只有五阶巅峰，双方的差距太大了。
如果这妞真对自己施展采补类功法，自己的小身板肯定扛不住，估计动用小黄心经也不好使。
这还是好的，万一真有什么操控类功法，自己哭都没地方哭。
离开了欢喜郡的黄夜，把下个目的地设定为慕欢宗。
随后陆续拜访那几家宗门势力，沿途还有一些势力并未在蓝玉帝宫安排人手，这些势力也要挨个走访。
这些势力的整体实力并不强，自己便能应对。
虽然不排除这一带有隐居的七阶层次强者，但让众女跟在自己身边的意义也不大。
也是因为这点，众女出来都要变成男修的样貌和体型，必须在脸上涂涂抹抹。
每次化妆就要一个小时，回去还要用卸妆水，操作过程很麻烦，黄夜干脆没让众女出来。
content_en:
"Isn't this normal? With the way this kid behaves, he will definitely not let me help. He is afraid that I will blackmail him."
"As for why he came here to look for me, I think he might have had a low level of cultivation, so he didn't come here until he broke through."
Yuan Qianqian analyzed it matter-of-factly.
"Although the head of the family's judgment makes sense, there is one point that cannot be explained."
"Normally, he shouldn't be short of money. He can spend a lot of money to hire a few expert guards, or simply hire someone to search for him. There is no need to put himself at risk."
Fairy Qiu asked.
"It can be explained that he didn't find a guard. It's just because he has money that he doesn't dare to hire an expert. He must be a loner and doesn't trust anyone around him."
"As for why he didn't hire someone to search for him, maybe he had a last resort. I don't know much about him, so I can't make an accurate judgment."
Yuan Qianqian forced to explain.
"Master, is there a possibility that the person who came here this time is not Manager Huang? The search for Fairy Tong is just the personal behavior of this inspector. He just used chicken feathers as arrows."
Fairy Qiu thought of another possibility.
"No matter what the possibility is, it's right for us to deal with this kid personally."
"Anyway, they don't come here often. As long as we provide good service during this period, they can't find any fault."
Yuan Qianqian interrupted their Goldbach conjecture.
"That's right. I'm really overthinking this. I'll arrange the specific matters right now."
Fairy Qiu bowed and retreated.
A playful smile appeared on the corner of Yuan Qianqian's mouth. Her smile was charming, sinister, and terrifying.
Brat, it's not really you this time, right? It would be strange if I don't eat you up when you get to my territory. Anyway, this is what I owe you.
Yuan Qianqian stretched out her little tongue and licked it around her lips, as if a big gray wolf had seen a fat sheep.
Huang Ye also didn't expect that Yuan Qianqian would target him at the beginning of the market and be so concerned about finding Tong Lao.
The two parties are at best acquaintances, and their acquaintance is also due to interests. It can be said that this girl has achieved her goal.
The agent meeting clearly stipulated that if you want to get more shares, you must bring out high-value treasures.
It's been a while since the meeting ended, but no one has sent a high-value treasure. This girl got 10% of the share without any blood, so what else does she need a bicycle?
Don't look at this girl saying she wants a 30% share, it's just a cover.
He didn't want to see this girl, just because she left a message before she left. She didn't want to owe him any favors, and she would definitely search for treasures when she returned.
This girl also wanted to use her body as a deposit and asked her to accept the deposit first. Seeing that she kept refusing, this girl proposed that the deposit can be withdrawn and used as many times as she wants, with no limit on the number of times.
Not to mention there is no limit to the number of times, even if it is only once, I would not dare to do it. Who knows what this girl is thinking.
She was a seventh-level, second-level monk, and she was only at the peak of the fifth level at that time. The gap between the two sides was too big.
If this girl really uses tonic skills on me, my small body will definitely not be able to bear it, and it is estimated that even using the Little Yellow Heart Sutra will not work.
This is still good. If there is any control technique, I won't have anywhere to cry.
Huang Ye, who left Huanxi County, set his next destination as Mu Huanzong.
Then he visited those sect forces one after another. There were some forces along the way that had not arranged manpower in the Blue Jade Emperor Palace. These forces also had to visit one by one.
The overall strength of these forces is not strong, and they can be dealt with by themselves.
Although he does not exclude the strong men of the seventh level who live in seclusion in this area, it does not make much sense to have the girls follow him.
It is also because of this that all the girls have to change into the appearance and body shape of male cultivators when they come out, and they must apply it on their faces.
It takes an hour to put on makeup each time, and you have to use makeup remover when you go back. The operation process is very troublesome, so Huang Ye simply didn't let the girls come out.
